facts.fact: The project 'Optimiser l'apprentissage par le numérique – Mise à l'échelle', launched 8 August 2025 and run jointly by Light for the World, UN-ABPAM and the Ministry of Secondary Education, aims to produce accessible digital teaching content and exams for 48 visually impaired pupils and 34 teachers.
facts.system: Optimiser l'apprentissage par le numérique – Mise à l'échelle

facts.fact: Light for the World's director says that with UN-ABPAM and the Ministry of National Education its earlier projects produced 606 accessible digital books and equipped 500 learners with reading devices.
facts.system: Light for the World / UN-ABPAM digital books projects
